title: Integral symmetric functions in odd power sums have coefficients with odd denominators
difficulty_reason: The q=2 target requires transferring integral symmetric-function data to 2-local coordinate integrality in the odd power-sum monomials, not a direct basis substitution. The author constructs an auxiliary denominator algebra V, proves z_lambda^{-1}p_lambda membership by a three-case induction with plethystic maps, embeds V into Lambda_Z_(2)+J, and uses Hall duality to extract each coefficient. These nonroutine denominator-control and incompatible-basis steps remain in the supplied author proof. H2 is based on that actual burden, not length or the general-prime strengthening.
